featured_reviews.name: Dhruvi Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
SRPT, where i went from learning certain concepts just 2 days before my exams in 9th and 10th grade to pretty much acing my physics tests only because of their amazing teaching skills.

Both Sahil Sir and Rakesh Sir explain concepts very well, and their notes are very easy to understand and retain. Their lectures are fun and engaging and oftentimes the highlight of my day. The way they explain super difficult concepts in a way that’s understandable to students is admirable. 90% of the time, the formulas are learnt in class itself. They are super approachable and create a comfortable learning environment where students feel encouraged rather than pressured.

They have assistant teachers like Divyesh sir, who is always ready to help students out anytime, whether offline or on Whatsapp. Their other assistant teacher, Anand sir, is amazing at breaking down difficult sums by writing every single step.

The entire team is awesome. They explain all questions very well, no matter how silly the doubt may be, and never judge us on how many marks we get.

To any student who wants to give their NEET exam, I highly recommend SRPT to learn physics from.

featured_reviews.name: Riddhi Bhavsar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Joining SRPT has honestly been one of the best decisions for my studies. The teachers here don’t just teach—they make sure you actually 'understand' physics. They explain everything so clearly and break down tough concepts in a way that just makes sense. Plus, you won't feel scared to approach them because they're always going to be there to help you.

Before coming here, I used to struggle with problem-solving, but now I feel way more confident tackling even tricky questions. The classes are interactive, and the support from the teachers is amazing. I’ve seen such a huge improvement in my understanding, and being a student who absolutely hated the subject, I actually enjoy learning physics now; All Thanks to this place :) . If you’re looking for a place that truly helps, this is it!
